items.why: The Dow is rallying 900 points and the Nasdaq is up 2% as stocks climb out of the postelection slump, so the fear gauge is falling sharply.
Barron's flags AMD as the beneficiary of Nvidia's troubles, with the stock rallying as investors rotate within chips.
No single headline; moving with the broader tape.
Nvidia stock slides after CEO Jensen Huang apologized for an affair, and the board is probing a spying case involving Huang.

market_note: Nasdaq futures up 3.11% and S&P futures up 2.0%, while oil falls 3.12%.
summary: Stocks are rebounding out of the postelection slump, with the Dow up 900 points and the Nasdaq up 2% as tech outside Nvidia climbs. The VIX is down sharply as fear eases, while Nvidia slides on its CEO controversy.
